statements.answer: No, starting tasks is honestly fine for me. Once I decide to do something I just get on with it. I have never really had that problem people talk about with staring at a task and not beginning.

statements.answer: No, I rarely forget things. Keys, wallet, phone — I always know where they are. My memory is perfectly good.

statements.answer: No difference anywhere. Home, work, out with friends — all the same, all fine.

statements.question: Are there things like sleep, stress, mood, or health that seem to make these experiences better or worse?
